source.title: Leanness Computation: Small Values and Special Graph Classes
source.scope_read: Section6.2, page18: the standard recursive cograph definition and equivalent P4-free characterization, credited there to Corneil et al.(1981). No leanness theorem is used.
source.access_limit: Direct DOI access to the original Corneil et al. article failed; the contemporary primary paper supplies the terminology. The profile theorem is proved from the recursive definition without relying on the equivalence.
